A '''rebellion''' was launched against [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Kinect" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Attack" /> farmers and dissidents were targeted by [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]. They were elminated using the weapon [[trihexalon]]. They started a covert rebellion, and then several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived on-planet to aid them after tracking [[Attack on Kashyyyk|captured]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] there. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] linked up with the leader [[Mak Pra]] after Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] informed her about reinforcements.<ref name="Kinect" />

==The attack==
The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was able to land his starship the ''[[Star Runner]]'' aboard the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Nihilist]]''. Two Jedi Padawans were able to free their fellows, and along with Master Zane, destroyed the reactor core. They then escaped, but crashed on the planet, where they fought more Trandoshan warriors. They then linked up with Mak Pra.<ref name="Kinect" />

[[File:Shu_Mai_and_guard.png|left|thumb|192x192px|Shu Mai during the battle]]
The next day, they launched an attack on [[Shu Mai's fortress]]. One of the Padawans was able to destroy the shield generator, and they went inside. Eventually they were captured and sentenced to death at the [[Ancient Abyss]]. Shu Mai revealed her plans to take revenge against the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. They were rescued and tried to capture Shu Mai, but she escaped. [[Ror]] and the other Zabrak warrior were killed in battle.<ref name="Kinect" />

They then went into orbit and met additional Republic reinforcements. Master Yoda ordered the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyers]] to concentrate on the [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Felucia)|Droid Control Ship]], destroying it.<ref name="Kinect" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Aftermath==
The Jedi followed the [[Subjugator (Subjugator-class)|''Subjugator'']] to Coruscant and destroyed it, ending the threat to the Senate.<ref name="Kinect" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rebellion appears in the Jedi Destiny portion of the [[2012]] [[Wikipedia:Kinect|Kinect]]-exclusive [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''.
